raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "tox-poetry-installer" %}
{% set version = "0.10.3" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name.replace('-', '_') }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 58af36082293b87e3488184f46ccf6f288c52c90e802066f53d3209c0f1c6226

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  number: 1

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - poetry-core >=1.1.0
    - pip
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }},<4.0
    - poetry-core >=1.1.0,<2.0.0
    - tox >=3.8.0,<4.0.0
  run_constrained:
    - cleo >=1.0,<3.0
    - poetry >=1.2.0,<1.5.0
test:
  imports:
    - tox_poetry_installer
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://github.com/enpaul/tox-poetry-installer/
  summary: A plugin for Tox that lets you install test environment dependencies from the Poetry lockfile
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.md

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - rxm7706
